verdict: DIRICHLET == RESTRICT — PASS (rel L2 2.31e-11 on the 3D interior, 1.13e-11 on the 1D field). The exact elimination reproduces the restricted solution to solver tolerance, and the exterior is identically zero (max|u| = 0.00e+00) because those dofs are removed rather than penalised. Two independently implemented formulations agreeing at this level is strong evidence neither has a bug.

PENALTY — differs from the reference by 2.82e-03 on the interior at penalty=0.0001, and leaves the exterior at max|u| = 8.45e-01 (want ~0). This is EXPECTED and is why the penalty formulation was abandoned: the dx(111) integral also hits the interface vertices shared with the 222 cells, so a penalty strong enough to pin the exterior contaminates the interior, and one weak enough to spare the interior does not pin the exterior. There is no good value; below ~1e-6 the matrix becomes singular (UMFPACK -5).
USE 'restrict' (21546 dofs) unless u3d is needed on the full background box; then use 'dirichlet' (68921 dofs, same answer). Both are exact and parameter-free. Do not use 'penalty'.
